title: Hardcoding Environmental Constants inside Client/Service Code
pattern: A service or library client hardcodes volatile environmental parameters (such as API endpoints, port configurations, or external credentials) directly inside the library source code.
why_bad: Forces a rebuild or re-compilation of the application binary to deploy the code to a different environment (e.g., testing against a sandbox environment vs. staging or production).
detection: Hardcoded URLs or IP address literals inside constructor functions or structs that do not allow overrides.
source: Andrew Hunt, David Thomas, *The Pragmatic Programmer* (2019), Topic 32, "Configuration", p. 581-582.
